surface_finishes.name: Standard
surface_finishes.description: Standard as-milled finish. Cutters leave visible tool marks. Surface roughness held to 125uin/3.2um Ra unless specified.

surface_finishes.name: Black Anodize
surface_finishes.description: Sulfuric acid anodizing (Type II) offering corrosion resistance and matte/gloss black appearance.

surface_finishes.name: Black Hardcoat Anodize
surface_finishes.description: Hardcoat anodizing (Type III) providing dense, wear-resistant thick ceramic coating in black.

surface_finishes.name: Blue Anodize
surface_finishes.description: Type II anodize dyed vibrant blue.

surface_finishes.name: Clear Anodize
surface_finishes.description: Type II anodize without dye, retaining natural silver metallic appearance with enhanced corrosion resistance.

surface_finishes.name: Clear Hardcoat Anodize
surface_finishes.description: Type III hardcoat anodize with superior wear resistance in natural/clear tone.

surface_finishes.name: Gold Anodize
surface_finishes.description: Type II anodize dyed gold.

surface_finishes.name: Gray Hardcoat Anodize
surface_finishes.description: Type III hardcoat anodize with matte gray appearance for heavy duty industrial use.

surface_finishes.name: Green Anodize
surface_finishes.description: Type II anodize dyed green.

surface_finishes.name: Orange Anodize
surface_finishes.description: Type II anodize dyed orange.

surface_finishes.name: PTFE Impregnated Hard Anodize
surface_finishes.description: Type III hardcoat anodize sealed with PTFE particles for ultra-low friction and high abrasion resistance.

surface_finishes.name: Purple Anodize
surface_finishes.description: Type II anodize dyed purple.

surface_finishes.name: Red Anodize
surface_finishes.description: Type II anodize dyed red.

surface_finishes.name: Yellow Anodize
surface_finishes.description: Type II anodize dyed yellow.

surface_finishes.name: Titanium Anodize
surface_finishes.description: Electrolytic passivation of titanium for color coding, biocompatibility, and anti-galling.

surface_finishes.name: Chem Film Clear
surface_finishes.description: Chromate conversion coating (MIL-DTL-5541 Type II Class 3) preserving conductivity and corrosion resistance.

surface_finishes.name: Chem Film Gold
surface_finishes.description: Hexavalent or trivalent chromate conversion coating (Class 1A) providing corrosion protection and primer base.

surface_finishes.name: Black Oxide
surface_finishes.description: Chemical conversion coating for steel and stainless steel offering mild corrosion resistance and black aesthetic.

surface_finishes.name: Passivate
surface_finishes.description: Chemical passivation (ASTM A967) for stainless steel and copper alloys, removing free iron and forming oxide barrier.

surface_finishes.name: Annealing
surface_finishes.description: Heat treatment altering microstructure to reduce hardness, increase ductility and eliminate internal residual stresses.

surface_finishes.name: Case Harden
surface_finishes.description: Carburizing or nitriding to harden surface layer while retaining tough, ductile core.

surface_finishes.name: Temper
surface_finishes.description: Low-temperature thermal processing following quenching to achieve desired toughness and hardness balance.

surface_finishes.name: Through Harden
surface_finishes.description: Thermal hardening throughout the entire workpiece cross-section.

surface_finishes.name: Bead Blast
surface_finishes.description: Fine glass bead blasting yielding a uniform, non-directional satin or matte textured finish.

surface_finishes.name: Tumbled
surface_finishes.description: Vibratory or centrifugal barrel tumbling to break sharp edges, deburr, and smooth part surfaces.

surface_finishes.name: Electroless Nickel Plating
surface_finishes.description: Autocatalytic chemical deposition of nickel-phosphorus alloy offering uniform thickness on complex geometry.

surface_finishes.name: Gold Plating
surface_finishes.description: Electroplated gold layer for high-end electrical contacts, corrosion immunity, and solderability.

surface_finishes.name: Silver Plating
surface_finishes.description: Electroplated silver layer providing high electrical and thermal conductivity.

surface_finishes.name: Zinc Plating
surface_finishes.description: Sacrificial electroplated zinc barrier for ferrous components preventing atmospheric corrosion.

surface_finishes.name: Electropolish
surface_finishes.description: Electrochemical deburring and micro-smoothing yielding brilliant mirror-like passive surface on stainless steel and copper.

surface_finishes.name: Cerakote
surface_finishes.description: Polymer-ceramic composite coating providing extreme corrosion, abrasion, and chemical resistance.

surface_finishes.name: Powder Coating
surface_finishes.description: Electrostatic dry powder application baked to a durable, decorative protective skin.

surface_finishes.name: Request finish
surface_finishes.description: Custom surface treatment not listed above; requires specification details and 2D drawing.

inserts.guidance: Attach a 2D drawing that calls out part numbers, quantities, and installation locations. Helicoils default to stainless steel 1.0*D; dowel pins to full depth.
